'''Alya Selray''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:TMT" />

==Biography==
BY [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|2}}</ref> she was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] where she tasked a Republic spacer to defeat a group of Mandalorian mercenaries that were hired by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] to kill Balmorran villagers and capturing others to sell as slaves.<ref name="TOR:TMT" />
